title: Day 26/28 - Azure DevOps End-to-End Project with Terraform |  Enterprise-Grade DevOps Project
description:
Join us for the penultimate day of our comprehensive Azure Terraform series as we bring together everything you've learned so far in a practical, enterprise-ready implementation. If you're looking to master modern DevOps workflows and strengthen your resume for cloud engineering positions, this video is essential viewing!

In this advanced tutorial, I will demonstrate a complete end-to-end project that showcases how real organizations manage infrastructure as code with Azure, Terraform, and Kubernetes. I will implement a feature branch-based workflow and create pipelines that automatically provision or destroy entire environments based on your team's development process.

What You'll Learn Today:
We'll build a sophisticated multi-environment deployment system where:

- Pull requests to feature branches or main automatically trigger infrastructure provisioning
- Custom Terraform modules create all necessary Azure resources (AKS clusters, service principals, Key Vault, secrets)
- Environment-specific configurations determine what gets deployed where
On-demand destruction of environments is possible through a dedicated pipeline

This comprehensive implementation addresses common interview questions about CI/CD, workflows, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native architecture. By following along and implementing this project yourself, you'll gain hands-on experience that stands out on your resume and demonstrates real-world DevOps expertise.

Perfect for cloud engineers, DevOps practitioners, and Azure enthusiasts who have been following our Terraform series and want to see how all the pieces fit together in a production-ready solution.
